### Stand Up and Lift Up Your Heads
Author: Scotty Smith
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/blogs/scotty-smith/stand-up-and-lift-up-your-heads/
Passage: Luke 21:28
Points:
- Jesus knows our struggles and surrounds us with unwavering, lavish love.
- Earthly distress and difficulty are expected realities between Christ's resurrection and His return.
- Believers do not fight for victory, but live from the victory Christ already won on the cross.
- Christians should reject fear, isolation, and conspiracy theories in times of crisis.
- Christ commands His followers to lift their heads with joy and stay faithfully on mission.

### How Can it Be “Gloriously Dark”?
Author: Adrian Rogers
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/loveworthfinding/love-worth-finding-september-11-2019.html
Passage: Luke 21:28
Points:
- Worldly distress and cultural darkness need not shake Christians who are grounded in Scripture.
- Troubling global events confirm the fulfillment of biblical prophecy regarding the end times.
- Lasting hope is found not in human institutions or science, but in the return of Jesus Christ.
- God gave prophecy so believers would remain spiritually alert rather than caught off guard.
- Current distressing headlines offer believers prime opportunities to share the gospel and Christ's return.
